FLOWVEL.name: FLOWVEL
FLOWVEL.why: C3: crop centre driven by RAFT flow displacement of the target region (damp 0.5); keeps following the flow-carried box while both views miss

SGGL.name: SGGL
SGGL.why: machine-matched SGGL baseline for every worker that runs arms (== diag trajectory on Ubuntu)

ORACLE_POOL.name: ORACLE_POOL
ORACLE_POOL.why: upper bound of causal rescue: GT picks the best of all 31 stage-1 candidates on co-absence frames (J>0.5), output + re-centre, no memory write. NOT deployable.

ORACLE_POOL_ADMIT.name: ORACLE_POOL_ADMIT
ORACLE_POOL_ADMIT.why: as ORACLE_POOL + the rescued candidate is written into the producing state's memory (D2). NOT deployable.

RESC_OCLR.name: RESC_OCLR
RESC_OCLR.why: stage-2 diagnostic causal arm (no family met advance_to_causal): on co-absence, L memory probed on a plain crop with target long side = 8 stride-16 cells at the flow-carried centre; accept iff SAM 2 object score > 0 (train-free, no fitted parameter -> evaluable on DEV+REP); output + re-centre. Stage-1 replay: 23 rescued / 5 FP frames, gains in 2 videos.

RESC_OCLR_ADMIT.name: RESC_OCLR_ADMIT
RESC_OCLR_ADMIT.why: RESC_OCLR + rescued output written into L memory (D2 memory admission)

RESC_CPFR.name: RESC_CPFR
RESC_CPFR.why: matched-magnification context-preserving foveation counterpart of RESC_OCLR (F family mechanism test under causal feedback). Stage-1 replay: 22 rescued / 39 FP frames.

K_OCLR_M3.name: K_OCLR_M3
K_OCLR_M3.why: stage-3 combination (motion control x rescue generation): RESC_OCLR on co-absence + M3-vel damped-velocity crop centre on every frame. Components target different episodes (drone crop escape vs skate-park/sheep fast re-acquisition). Synergy test: vs RESC_OCLR, M3vel, SGGL (same machine).

K_OCLR_FLOWVEL.name: K_OCLR_FLOWVEL
K_OCLR_FLOWVEL.why: stage-3 combination: RESC_OCLR + FLOWVEL flow-driven crop centre. Synergy test vs RESC_OCLR, FLOWVEL, SGGL.

FV_PRESENT.name: FV_PRESENT
FV_PRESENT.why: FLOWVEL ablation (frozen after FLOWVEL PROMISING): damped flow velocity only while SGGL output is present; crop stays put while absent (as SGGL). Isolates the velocity part.

FLOWCARRY.name: FLOWCARRY
FLOWCARRY.why: FLOWVEL ablation: no velocity; while the output is empty the crop follows the RAFT flow-carried target box. Isolates the absence-tracking part.

CAMCARRY.name: CAMCARRY
CAMCARRY.why: FLOWVEL ablation / C3: while the output is empty the crop moves with the CAMERA motion (median flow outside the target box) instead of the target-region flow. Tests whether target-local flow matters.

K_ADMIT_FLOWVEL.name: K_ADMIT_FLOWVEL
K_ADMIT_FLOWVEL.why: stage-3 combination frozen AFTER seeing RESC_OCLR_ADMIT (+0.0046, only rescue variant with positive mean) and FLOWVEL (+0.0130): motion control x memory-admitted rescue. Exploratory (post-hoc choice disclosed). Synergy test vs FLOWVEL, RESC_OCLR_ADMIT.

FLOWVEL_U.name: FLOWVEL_U
FLOWVEL_U.why: cross-machine replication of FLOWVEL (identical spec) on the Ubuntu RTX 2080, matched to the Ubuntu diag SGGL trajectory; frozen after FLOWVEL PROMISING on RunPod
